This seed is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in coniferous forests, and is best known in western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

Carefree Mustard seeds are carefully prepared and applied to wounds. The treatment restores 3–30 concussion hits in about an hour. Such substantial healing is offset by the plant's extraordinary rarity: finding it is almost impossible even when one knows its preferred forest habitat.
